counterfactual_missing_items: C1 lacks direct reference to Michaelis-Gutmann bodies
C1 does not include histiocytic proliferation or special stain findings
decisive_items: Intracytoplasmic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies present as basophilic, somewhat laminated intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies measuring 5-8 μm in diameter
Bodies highlighted with iron (Prussian blue) and calcium (Von Kossa) stains
response.rationale: R2 provides the pathognomonic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies and special stain confirmation, which are definitive for malakoplakia. C1 adds anatomical site and E. coli etiology but relies on R2 for the core diagnosis; its raw spans alone are insufficient to establish malakoplakia.
